recognize_zh: 細胞學抹片中可見許多中大型異常淋巴樣細胞，核圓至不規則、染色質細緻、部分有核仁、細胞質藍色，並混有大量嗜中性球；但本圖保存不佳，看不到 Burkitt 典型的深藍細胞質與脂質空泡，僅部分符合。
features: Numerous medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with round to irregular or folded nuclei and fine chromatin
Some cells with small nucleoli and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Characteristic cytoplasmic lipid vacuoles are not convincingly seen in this field
Abundant admixed segmented neutrophils and occasional small lymphocytes
Suboptimal preservation with smudged nuclear detail and a proteinaceous background
describe_en: Cytologic preparation shows a population of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with numerous neutrophils. The classic deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles is not convincingly demonstrated, and cell preservation is suboptimal. The atypical cells are compatible with a high-grade lymphoma, but the morphology in this field is not specific for Burkitt lymphoma; confirmation requires immunophenotyping (CD10+, BCL2-, Ki-67 near 100%) and MYC rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are more pleomorphic and larger with variable Ki-67 and BCL2 expression, requiring immunophenotype and MYC/BCL2 FISH to separate from Burkitt.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: It can mimic Burkitt morphology but shows BCL2 protein and rearrangement on FISH.
Blasts are TdT or CD34 positive (lymphoblastic) or MPO positive (myeloid), whereas Burkitt cells are TdT-negative mature B cells with surface immunoglobulin.
